about.title: Chula Vista Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Fifteen people did not come home from Chula Vista's roads in 2025. Behind that public-record number are households making arrangements no one planned for, sorting bills, and carrying on without someone. If that is where your family is, we are sorry. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects families across Chula Vista and San Diego County with an independent wrongful death attorney who works on contingency. Under California law, a wrongful death claim is a civil action, separate from any criminal case, brought first by a spouse, domestic partner, or children, and in some situations by other dependents or heirs. Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and the love, companionship, and guidance your family lost. Whether the crash happened on Broadway, Olympic Parkway, Main Street, 4th Avenue, or a quiet residential street, the two-year deadline from the date of death applies, and it shrinks when a government entity is involved.

whyChoose.title: Why Chula Vista Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney we connect you with can sort out early who in your family is eligible so nothing is filed by the wrong person.

items.title: The clock is tracked from day one
items.desc: Families generally have two years from the date of death, but that window is much shorter when a city, county, or state agency may share fault. Getting matched early protects your options.

items.title: Every category of loss is counted
items.desc: Beyond funeral and burial costs, California allows recovery for lost financial support and for the love, companionship, and guidance your family no longer has. A civil claim proceeds on its own track, regardless of whether prosecutors bring charges.

items.question: A criminal case is already open in San Diego County. Do we have to wait for it to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves separately from any prosecution. Waiting can actually cost you, because the two-year civil deadline keeps running while the criminal matter plays out. An attorney can often use evidence from the criminal file while pursuing your family's claim in parallel.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to bring the claim?
items.answer: California gives the first right to a surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and to the children. If none exist, the claim may pass to others who would inherit, and in some cases to dependents such as a parent or stepchild who relied on the person financially. The attorney will confirm exactly which relatives qualify.

items.question: Does it matter that the crash happened on a city street like Broadway or Olympic Parkway?
items.answer: It can. If a Chula Vista, San Diego County, or Caltrans vehicle, road condition, or signal is part of what went wrong, a government claim must be filed on a far shorter timeline than the usual two years. Even when only private drivers are involved, the location shapes which records and cameras exist, which is why acting quickly helps.
